diagnostic.why_a_revision_was_allowed: WP420-05 §5 states Δt = 2/60 s, τ = 30 s, γ = exp(-Δt/τ) as the initial configuration and explicitly not as a claim about the optimum, and it allows one learning-rate/KL-style revision backed by a concrete diagnostic.  The failed item reward_discount_horizon is that diagnostic.

measured_task_length.class: the one real recorded Stage-1 clear (T04 shard, seed 12)

failure_at_tau_30.verdict: the frozen τ = 30 s gives a 900.5-decision horizon against a 6,598-decision task: the terminal clear bonus is invisible

rule.statement: the smallest τ in TAU_CANDIDATE_SECONDS whose γ^T at the measured clear length T = 6598 decisions reaches gamma_T_clear_min; ties broken towards the shorter effective horizon (the smaller τ)
rule.no_lookahead: γ^T is a function of Δt, τ and the already-measured clear length only, so the table could be and was computed before any audit or training result existed; no result-dependent quantity enters the selection

selected.selected_by: the smallest candidate τ whose γ^T at the measured clear length reaches the floor; because both γ^T and the horizon grow monotonically with τ, this is also the minimal horizon extension the rule allows
selected.admissible_alternatives: 300/400/600 s also clear the floor (γ^T = 0.480/0.577/0.693) and would have been chosen only by a rule that also demanded a longer horizon than the floor requires

rejected_initial_configuration.why_rejected: γ^T over the real task length is 6.55e-04, so a terminal clear bonus is smaller than one death penalty by three orders of magnitude

floor_is_not_a_relaxed_tolerance.old_implicit_criterion: stage_clear_bonus·γ^T > death_penalty, i.e. γ^T > 0.25 on the audited table
floor_is_not_a_relaxed_tolerance.second_threshold_is_new: the old criterion said nothing about the class margin; the added |clear|/|early_death| ≥ 1.5 requirement is a criterion the previous verdict did not even check
floor_is_not_a_relaxed_tolerance.cannot_be_lowered_by_a_config: resolve_discount_floor refuses any value below the frozen floor, so a later run cannot relax the gate to pass it
floor_is_not_a_relaxed_tolerance.why_the_ratio_is_stated_on_magnitudes: the worse class' discounted return is negative, so the literal signed form clear ≥ 1.5·early_death is satisfied by any positive clear return and does NOT reject τ = 30 s (at τ = 30 s clear = 0.006047 and 1.5·early_death = -0.174366).  The magnitude form rejects it by 28x
floor_is_not_a_relaxed_tolerance.what_it_would_reject_instead: a τ that hides the terminal event (τ = 30 s), and a clear whose discounted return is less than 1.5x an early death's — both are real failure modes of credit assignment, not cosmetic thresholds

notes: only τ (and the γ it implies) changed; every reward coefficient is byte-identical to the table reward_ordering passed before the revision
the second threshold is stated on magnitudes because the signed form is vacuous when the worse class' return is negative
γ is always recomputed from Δt/τ by the module, and both the config loader and the audit refuse a published γ that disagrees with it
one revision was taken and no further τ will be tried: if the item had still failed the report would have said fail and stopped
